BackstoryDef.title: enclave officer heir
BackstoryDef.description: Born inside the isolated stronghold of the pre-war government's remnants, [PAWN_nameDef] was raised to believe [PAWN_possessive] people were the sole legitimate heirs to civilization. Taught from birth to view wasteland inhabitants as corrupted mutants, [PAWN_pronoun] excelled in military command.

BackstoryDef.title: enclave field commander
BackstoryDef.description: Commanding the Enclave's expeditionary forces across the Capital Wasteland, [PAWN_nameDef] combines aristocratic poise with ruthless military pragmatism. Unwilling to bow blindly to automated directives, [PAWN_pronoun] seeks to seize vital infrastructure and impose absolute order by force.

BackstoryDef.title: sterile bunker prodigy
BackstoryDef.description: Sheltered from radiation and surface squalor inside an offshore facility, [PAWN_nameDef] spent [PAWN_possessive] youth peering through microscopes and memorizing biochemical formulas. [PAWN_pronoun] grew up convinced that science could cleanse a broken world.

BackstoryDef.title: chemical corps director
BackstoryDef.description: Head of the Enclave's Chemical Corps, [PAWN_nameDef] engineered lethal airborne toxins designed to wipe out every mutated organism on the mainland. Polite and soft-spoken in [PAWN_possessive] lab coat, [PAWN_pronoun] calmly justifies mass extinction as a necessary medical procedure.

BackstoryDef.title: barracks disciplinarian
BackstoryDef.description: Even as a young recruit, [PAWN_nameDef] possessed lungs loud enough to rattle bunker bulkheads and an obsession with spotless gear. [PAWN_pronoun] never tolerated sloppy posture, missing equipment, or hesitation on the drill ground.

BackstoryDef.title: furious drill instructor
BackstoryDef.description: Infamous across every Enclave outpost for volcanic tirades and bone-crushing standards, [PAWN_nameDef] terrorizes new troopers into peak combat readiness. Anyone caught out of uniform or missing a piece of power armor quickly wishes they were facing a deathclaw instead.

BackstoryDef.title: vanguard trooper cadet
BackstoryDef.description: Trained from childhood in sealed combat simulators and live-fire ranges, [PAWN_nameDef] mastered heavy armor movement before reaching adulthood. [PAWN_pronoun] viewed surface dwellers strictly as hostile targets blocking the reclamation of the homeland.

BackstoryDef.title: hellfire shock commander
BackstoryDef.description: Leading elite shock troopers clad in experimental thermal power armor, [PAWN_nameDef] spearheads scorched-earth assaults against fortified enemy positions. Cold, fanatical, and heavily armed, [PAWN_pronoun] leaves nothing behind save ash and molten slag.
